## File: google-deepmind_flowsforatomicsolids/utils/lattice_utils.py

Prompts

```
['build a shifted cubic lattice with atoms at unit cell centres given box bounds and cell aspect', 'build an orthorhombic lattice of repeated unit cells with custom atom positions within each cell', 'compute the GCD of a list of numbers including floats with a configurable tolerance', 'review the make_simple_lattice function that generates a shifted cubic lattice from lower and upper bounds', 'review the make_lattice function that builds an orthorhombic lattice with atoms per unit cell', 'compute the radial distribution function g(r) for particle coordinates in a periodic box', 'compute pairwise distance vectors between particles obeying periodic boundary conditions in a simulation box', 'estimate the free energy difference using the Free Energy Perturbation estimator from forward work values', 'compute the effective sample size ESS percentage from model and target log probabilities', 'compute an importance sampling weighted estimate of the mean value of data using model and target log probabilities']
```

Usage

```
{'build_simple_lattice': 'build a shifted cubic lattice with atoms at unit cell centres given box bounds and cell aspect', 'build_orthorhombic_lattice': 'build an orthorhombic lattice of repeated unit cells with custom atom positions within each cell', 'compute_gcd_of_floats': 'compute the GCD of a list of numbers including floats with a configurable tolerance', 'review_make_simple_lattice': 'review the make_simple_lattice function that generates a shifted cubic lattice from lower and upper bounds', 'review_make_lattice': 'review the make_lattice function that builds an orthorhombic lattice with atoms per unit cell'}
```
